binary_response_model.eta: logit(p_ref) + theta_p + u_pf + v_po + form_shift_f + practice_shift*I(occasion=2) + form_second_interaction*I(form=B,occasion=2)

random_effects.u_pf: Normal(0, person_by_form_sd^2), independent by person and form
random_effects.v_po: Normal(0, person_by_occasion_sd^2), independent by person and occasion

binary_response_model.note: Simulation sensitivity model for calibration-design selection, not an empirical iid-Bernoulli claim about real Math Challenge responses.

estimators.combined_form_effect: F_hat = lambda1*F1_hat + lambda2*F2_hat, only when consistency gate passes
estimators.combined_form_practice_covariance: CFP_hat = lambda2*C2P_hat because Stage-1 is independent of Stage-2
estimators.independent_decision_pair_variance: VD_hat = var(d_AB) for AB target; var(d_BA) for BA target
estimators.adjusted_change_variance: Vadj_hat = VD_hat + VF_hat + VP_hat + 2*orientation_sign*CFP_hat; Cov(D_observed,F_hat)=Cov(D_observed,P_hat)=0 by independent decision-pair design
estimators.invalid_variance_rule: If any required variance/weight/covariance is non-finite, V1_hat<=0, V2_hat<=0, Vadj_hat<=0, or SE_adj_hat is non-finite, the replicate is INDETERMINATE/numeric failure and is never dropped.

decision_criterion.alpha_interpretation: Nominal two-sided normal-reference cutoff only. Actual operating false-positive control is adjudicated prospectively by the frozen Monte Carlo false-reliable-change gate; exact .05 finite-sample control is not assumed.
decision_criterion.indeterminate_rule: Any failed/missing calibration-integrity, model-eligibility, scope-binding, MeasurementSpec, or required finite positive variance gate => INDETERMINATE

oracle.purpose: Estimate scenario population moments needed for the frozen variance functional: Stage-1 form score variances, AB/BA contrast variances, and true form/practice corrections. For each candidate design and decision orientation, derive the design-reference SE_adj by substituting oracle population moments into the same frozen Vadj algebra.
oracle.reference_semantics: SE_adj_reference is the population-moment reference for the frozen plug-in variance functional. Finite-sample randomness of estimated inverse-variance weights remains part of end-to-end Monte Carlo operating behavior and is controlled by the direct false-positive gate rather than assumed away.

simulation_execution.screen_hard_fail_rule: Exclude before confirm only when a 99% Monte Carlo interval for at least one gating metric lies wholly on the failing side.
simulation_execution.confirm_rule: Evaluate non-hard-failed designs in frozen minimum-design order; no early PASS before all 20,000 confirm replications complete.

non_gating_false_negative_reporting.reason: No validated Math Challenge SESOI exists.
non_gating_false_negative_reporting.population: independent decision pair as frozen in decision_population; true_change_logit is injected on occasion 2 only in the decision pair and never into calibration samples
non_gating_false_negative_reporting.denominator: all attempted sensitivity replications for that design x scenario x shift; indeterminate/numeric failures remain in denominator
non_gating_false_negative_reporting.sentinel_scope: S09 excluded from sensitivity/power reporting; it remains governed only by its frozen misspecification-sentinel safety gates
non_gating_false_negative_reporting.execution_scope: confirmatorily evaluated designs only; R_confirm per design x core scenario x shift

monte_carlo_intervals.continuous_mean_metrics: MCSE = sample SD/sqrt(R); CI = mean +/- z*MCSE
monte_carlo_intervals.invalid_replications: count as indeterminate/numeric failure; never silently drop

worst_case_rule.core: Pass only if every gating metric passes in every core scenario; no averaging.
worst_case_rule.no_pass: Return NO_ADMISSIBLE_DESIGN_IN_FROZEN_GRID; no interpolation, extrapolation, or tolerance changes.

governance.amendment_rule: Any change after outputs are seen creates a new protocol version; seen results become development data.

decision_population.participant_relation_to_calibration: independent participant; excluded from Stage-1 and Stage-2 calibration estimation
decision_population.decision_pair_order_allocation: exact 1:1 across each even-sized Monte Carlo phase by replicate parity
decision_population.order_rule: AB when replicate_index % 2 == 0; BA when replicate_index % 2 == 1
decision_population.sensitivity_true_change_application: add true_change_logit * I(occasion=2) to the independent decision-pair eta only; retain the scenario practice shift, form shift, and form-second interaction unchanged
decision_population.calibration_true_change_application: none; calibration samples always use the frozen scenario model without sensitivity true-change injection
decision_population.sensitivity_replications: R_confirm per confirmatorily evaluated design x core scenario S01-S08 x shift; descriptive/non-gating; S09 is excluded from sensitivity/power because it is the model-misspecification sentinel
decision_population.false_positive_population: one independent decision pair per replicate with true_change_logit=0
decision_population.false_positive_denominator: all attempted replications in the applicable phase for that design x scenario; indeterminate/numeric failures remain in the denominator and are not silently dropped
decision_population.generation_model: same frozen scenario binary-response DGM, with fresh target-participant random effects and binomial draws independent of all calibration draws
decision_population.calibration_estimates_applied: use F_hat, P_hat, and variance/covariance estimates from the same Monte Carlo replicate calibration sample
decision_population.simulation_burden_status: target decision pair is an operating-characteristic probe only; it is not added to candidate calibration participant counts or minimum-design response burden

data_completeness.generated_score_requirement: Every Stage-1 score, both scores in every Stage-2 repeated-measure pair, and both scores in the independent decision pair must be generated as finite complete bounded scores from the frozen DGM.
data_completeness.no_partial_pair_rule: No partial Stage-2 or decision pair is admissible. No dropout, item nonresponse, administrative censoring, timeout censoring, truncation, imputation, pairwise deletion, or complete-case subsampling is simulated in GB-MEASURE-01F-EXEC v1.2.
data_completeness.generation_failure_rule: If the executor cannot generate every required complete finite score for a Monte Carlo replicate, the entire replicate is INDETERMINATE/NUMERICAL_FAILURE; it remains in every applicable all-attempted-replications denominator and is never repaired or dropped.
data_completeness.future_extension_rule: Any missingness/censoring sensitivity analysis requires a new prospective protocol version with a frozen mechanism, rates, handling, and acceptance/reporting rules.

required_runtime.version_mismatch_rule: Exact 01F-EXEC parity requires these versions. A different Python or NumPy version must not be used for the governed execution without a prospective amendment and fresh review.

randomness_contract.replicate_index_convention: 0-based for screen, confirm, and sensitivity_false_negative. Oracle uses replicate_index 0..R_oracle-1.
randomness_contract.component_usage: Every component has an independently hashed seed and its own Generator. Only decision_AB or decision_BA is used in a replicate according to the frozen parity rule. Because component streams are separately keyed, component execution order and parallel scheduling cannot change another component's random stream.

stage1_A_or_B: p = logistic(frozen eta for the assigned form/occasion)
decision_AB_or_BA: draw occasion-1 binomial count for the first form in the frozen order
draw occasion-2 binomial count for the second form in the frozen order

randomness_contract.no_unfrozen_randomness_rule: No global RNG, OS entropy, wall-clock seed, implicit library default RNG, hand-edited seed list, or executor-selected stream partition is permitted.
